points.title: Nationwide coverage
points.text: Safe shipping to every governorate with inspection before payment.

sections.text: We ship to every governorate in Egypt within 2–5 business days. Shipping fees depend on the governorate and are shown before you confirm your order.

sections.heading: Cash on delivery
sections.text: Available in most governorates, with inspection before you pay.
You can return a product within 14 days in its original condition with the invoice. Custom-made items cannot be returned.
We respect your privacy. Your details (name, phone, address) are used only for delivery and are never shared with third parties.
By browsing the site or placing an order you agree to these terms. Prices are in Egyptian pounds and include VAT unless stated otherwise.
